hook_card.text:
ولدتي والخطوط بقاو؟
السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت
hook_card.red: السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت

shots.vo_line: شوفي فيا… خطوط حمرين وخطوط بيضين، ومحفورين شوية. من نهار
shots.row: The belly character (a Pixar-style walking belly like the reference photo: navel, beige waistband, clear red and white stretch marks, sweet face on the upper belly, small arms and legs) sitting sad on a zellige bathroom floor
shots.h3_prompt: The belly sniffles, lifts her teary eyes and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, pressing her hands on her stretch marks to show them. A tear rolls down her cheek and she wipes it with the back of her hand. She keeps rocking gently on the floor, breathing in shaky sobs and blinking, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: ولدتي وأنا هكا. ونتي كتخبيني تحت التريكو، وكتحسابي غادي يمشيو بوحدهم.
shots.row: The belly character hiding under a long T-shirt in front of the mirror, only her eyes peeking out
shots.h3_prompt: The belly's eyes dart left and right above the T-shirt collar and she blinks nervously. She rises a little out of the collar until her mouth shows and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, the shirt bobbing with each word. She keeps fidgeting under the shirt, toes wiggling on the rug, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the mouth starts hidden under the collar (the motion lifts her out of it to talk); the round mirror shows no reflection of her, so H3 may invent one.

shots.vo_line: ولكن المشكل ماشي فوقي، المشكل لتحت: فالحمل الكرش كبرات بالزربة، وأنا ما قدرتش نتبعها، فتقطعت من
shots.row: Cross-section under the belly character: snapped pink threads
shots.h3_prompt: The belly looks down at the torn pink threads in her open middle, her smile fading into worry. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, pointing at the snapped ends, which twitch and fray. She shakes her head sadly and keeps rubbing her sides with both hands, sighing and blinking, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: لتحت. وكل ليلة كتجربي فيا: الشبة مع زيت جونسون… الشبة كتحرقني، والزيت كيبقى فوقي. زيت الزيتون واللوز من تيك توك… تقال ولزقو
shots.row: Quick shots: an alum stone rubbing her with red sparks; oil sitting on her surface; olive and almond oil stuck on a T-shirt; a coffee-and-sugar bowl scrubbing her red; a cream tube with a 250 DH tag
shots.h3_prompt: The belly rubs the alum stone in small circles on her side, red sparks crackling, and winces. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while the oil keeps pouring onto her head and pools in shiny drops on her skin. She shakes her head, flicking the drops, and keeps rubbing and grimacing until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the row's olive and almond oil on a T-shirt is not in the frame.

shots.vo_line: فالتريكو. القهوة مع السكر… حكاتني حتى حمّرت. والكريمة ب250 درهم… رطبات الفوق وصافي. كلشي كيبقى من برا… والجرح لتحت.
shots.row: Quick shots: an alum stone rubbing her with red sparks; oil sitting on her surface; olive and almond oil stuck on a T-shirt; a coffee-and-sugar bowl scrubbing her red; a cream tube with a 250 DH tag
shots.h3_prompt: The belly sets the oil bottle and the alum stone down, bends to the bowl, scoops the coffee and sugar and scrubs her belly; the skin turns red and she yelps. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, patting the cream tube with a sad shrug. She keeps rubbing her reddened skin and sighing until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the cream tube has no 250 DH tag (fine, it would be text).

shots.vo_line: أنا خاصني اللي يدخل لتحت. غوتيفا: سيروم خفيف، كنشربو كامل دغيا، وكيوصل للجرح. زيت أركان كيغذيني، فيتامين E كيعاوني نبرا،
shots.row: The Guttiva bottle on the marble counter, a golden drop sinking into her, the threads glowing
shots.h3_prompt: The golden drop falls from the dropper and sinks into her skin, a warm glow rippling outward. The belly talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures as she squeezes out another drop. She keeps rubbing the glowing spot, swaying happily, until the glow fills her stretch marks. The bottle keeps its exact shape and label, standing still. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the label small print is garbled (e.g. 'BLANCHES 27 BOUDES EXISTANTES'). Brand name, SERUM, ANTI-VERGETURES and 60 ml read correctly.

shots.vo_line: والألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية. ما كيحرقنيش بحال الشبة، ما كيلزقش بحال الزيت، ما كيحكنيش بحال القهوة،
shots.row: The belly character with a pink headband lifting tiny dumbbells, happy and glowing
shots.h3_prompt: The belly pumps the little dumbbells up and down in a bouncy rhythm, beaming. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures between lifts, bouncing on her toes while her skin glows softly. She marches in place and keeps curling the dumbbells with a proud grin until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: وما كيبقاش فوقي بحال الكريمة. دقيقتين الصباح والعشية… فـ30 يوم الحمرين كيخفّو، فـ60
shots.row: The belly character with a pink headband lifting tiny dumbbells, happy and glowing
shots.h3_prompt: The belly does a little side-to-side squat with the dumbbells held out in front, then lifts them overhead with a happy hop. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, giving a playful wink. She keeps swaying her hips and pumping the dumbbells overhead, glowing and breathing, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: البيضين كيقربو للون ديالي، وفـ90 يوم كتلبسي اللي بغيتي. وخلي زيت الزيتون للسلاطة.
shots.row: She holds a calendar card with three circled days, then winks and pushes an olive-oil bottle toward a salad bowl
shots.h3_prompt: The belly finishes pouring the olive oil over the salad, tips the bottle upright, sets it down and nudges it toward the bowl. She talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, giving a cheeky wink. She keeps wiggling her hips in a happy little dance, laughing, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Frame differs from its row: there is no calendar card with circled days (fine, it would carry numbers) and she already pours the oil into the salad instead of pushing the bottle.
